_note: Written BEFORE any run of this rule and before any price frame was read by this track (no signal, no simulation, no data check had been run). IN SAMPLE ONLY: every frame is read with ts < 2022-01-01; nothing dated 2022 or later is read.
frozen_name: LETF_CLOSE_PAIR: Nasdaq-100 against the Dow in the last half hour of big days
frozen_rule:
CLOCK AND DAYS: New York; NYSE full sessions; early closes skipped.

SIGNAL at 15:30:
- d_i = ln(mid close of the 15:29 bar / mid close of the previous session's 15:59 bar), for us100 and us30.
- sd_d = sd of d_us100 over the previous 60 sessions.
- Condition: sign(d_us100) = sign(d_us30) and |d_us100| >= 1.25 x sd_d.

HEDGE: h = sd(us100 15:30->15:59 return) / sd(us30 15:30->15:59 return), over the previous 60 sessions.

ENTRY at the open of the 15:30 bar:
- if d > 0: BUY us100 (N) and SELL us30 (h x N);
- if d < 0: SELL us100 and BUY us30.

STOP: pair mark pi as in IDXRS_1000. Close both legs when pi <= -1.5 x sd_pi, where sd_pi = sd of the hedged, direction-signed 15:30->15:59 pair return over the previous 60 sessions.

EXIT: both legs at the open of the 15:59 bar. One pair a day.

SIZING: R = net pi / (1.5 x sd_pi).
frozen_test_plan:
11 configurations. The verdict is read on (1) only.

(1) Main, as in 'rule'.

Neighbours:
(2) threshold 1.0 sd
(3) threshold 1.5 sd
(4) entry 15:40
(5) exit 15:57
(6) exit 16:05 (dropped before the run if the frames have no us100 and us30 quotes after 16:00 NY)
(7) pair stop 1.25 sd_pi
(8) pair stop 1.75 sd_pi
(9) us100 against us500

Stress: (10) main at costs x1.5.

Null: (11) 200 replays of the main's pairs at 15:30 on randomly drawn sessions, with the same legs, side, stop and holding time.

COST: pair round trip about 1.5 bp (spreads 0.37 + 0.35 bp scaled by h; 0.2 bp market slippage per side per leg); +0.6 bp on stop fills; no swap.

PASS = PROTOCOL_V3 s.4 single-sleeve bars, plus a knife-edge rule declared now (the lesson of close_run_1725): both exit neighbours, (5) and (6), must have PF >= 1.06.

REPORTED: weekly correlation with IDXRS_1000 and with noise30; result split by the day's direction.

Expected n about 370.
frozen_instruments: us100 against us30: FP cash CFDs, frames lab/data/fp. us100 against us500 is a neighbour.
frozen_why:
P = 0.08 (in sample) x 0.20 (VAL given an in-sample pass) = 1.6 %. Correlation with the account about 0.10, q 0.45.

SUB-SCORES (0-10):
- prior 2
- trades 4: about 45 a year, about 370 in 2014-2021
- independence 6: market-neutral, but it shares 15:30-15:55 with noise30 and the session with IDXRS_1000
- cost 4: needs about 3.0-3.5 bp gross against a 1.5 bp pair round trip, about 2x
- simplicity 5
- MQL5/FP 8: us100 0.3 lot against us30 0.2 lot, about 1.35 % risk

RECORD:
- Outright end-of-day momentum earns 1.4 / 0.6 / 0.4 bp gross per trade on us100 / us500 / us30 (_paused_state.json research_idx_us.rejected). That is the order leveraged-ETF assets predict, but it gives only about 0.9 bp for the hedged pair on all days, so big days must lift it about 3-4x.
- Never simulated as a pair.
- Close-of-session rules are knife-edges in this lab: close_run_1725 fell from PF 1.502 to 1.132 / 1.169 with the exit one minute either side, and was not confirmed in VAL (results/r2/idx_eu/report.txt).
- It reuses IDXRS_1000's two-leg simulator, so it costs little to add.

readings_of_open_details.R1_period_and_sessions: In sample only: every price frame is read with the parquet row filter ts < 2022-01-01 and the slices are passed explicitly to every function; nothing dated 2022 or later is read. Sessions = NYSE full sessions from the rule-based calendar already used by noise30 / ocm4 / IDXRS_1000 (r2/tracks/idx_us/idxus_lib.calendar_flags, imported read-only): weekdays that are neither a full closure nor a 13:00 early close. Early-close days are not sessions (not traded, not counted in any look-back window). The session list runs from 2013-09-30 (first day of the us30 frame) to 2021-12-31 and is the SAME list for every configuration, (9) us100/us500 included, so that (9) differs from the main by the instrument only. Trades are counted from the first one the warm-up allows.
readings_of_open_details.R2_bars: 'the 15:29 bar', 'the 15:30 bar', 'the 15:59 bar' = the M1 bar that STARTS at that New York minute (bars are labelled by their start; DST handled by the tz database). The decision at 15:30 uses the close of the 15:29 bar, known at 15:30. Mid = (bid + ask) / 2. Every bar the signal names must exist exactly (no forward fill): if the 15:29 bar of the day or the 15:59 bar of the previous session is missing for an index, its d is missing that day (no trade, no value in the look-back windows).
readings_of_open_details.R3_previous_session: 'the previous session' = the previous NYSE trading day (weekday that is not a full closure). When that day was a 13:00 early close it has no 15:59 cash-session bar: d is then missing for both indices and the day is not traded (and gives no value to the sd_d and sd_pi windows). This is the conservative reading, and the one of the lab's frozen noise30, which ignores the previous close after an early close. After a full closure (holiday, weekend) the previous session is the last trading day before it.
readings_of_open_details.R4_signal_condition: d_i = ln(mid close of the day's 15:29 bar / mid close of the previous session's 15:59 bar), i = us100 and leg 2 (us30; us500 in (9)). Condition: d_us100 and d_leg2 both strictly positive or both strictly negative (a zero has no sign: no trade), and |d_us100| >= thr x sd_d (thr = 1.25; 1.0 / 1.5 in (2) / (3)). 'd > 0' / 'd < 0' in the entry text = that common sign; direction dir = sign(d_us100).
readings_of_open_details.R5_sd_d: sd_d = sample standard deviation (ddof = 1) of d_us100 over the finite values among the previous 60 sessions (the current session excluded), at least 40 values. The text gives no minimum; 40 of 60 is the minimum the sister rule IDXRS_1000 states for its 60-session windows (this rule reuses its pair mark and stop).
readings_of_open_details.R6_hedge: h = sd_us100 / sd_leg2, sd = sample sd (ddof = 1) of each index's log return from the mid OPEN of the 15:30 bar to the mid OPEN of the 15:59 bar (the main's holding period, as the rule writes '15:30->15:59'), each over its own finite values among the previous 60 sessions, at least 40; a day's return is missing if either bar is missing. N on us100, h x N on leg 2. The windows stay at 15:30->15:59 in EVERY configuration (no neighbour names them: a neighbour changes only what it names).
readings_of_open_details.R7_sd_pi: For every previous session j (traded or not) with a defined direction dir_j = sign(d_us100,j): pi_j = dir_j x (r_us100,j - h_j x r_leg2,j), with the mid 15:30-open -> 15:59-open returns of R6 and day j's own h_j (from day j's own trailing windows). sd_pi = sample sd (ddof = 1) of pi over the finite values among the previous 60 sessions, at least 40. A day trades only if the condition of R4 holds and h > 0 and sd_pi > 0 are defined.
readings_of_open_details.R8_entry: Both legs need an M1 bar starting exactly at the entry minute (15:30; 15:40 in (4)); otherwise the signal is not entered ('if one leg fails'). Fills at the open: the long leg at ask x (1 + 0.2 bp), the short leg at bid x (1 - 0.2 bp), same minute; d > 0: long us100 (N) and short leg 2 (h x N); d < 0: short us100 (N) and long leg 2 (h x N). In (4) the SIGNAL stays at 15:30 (15:29 bar) and the windows at 15:30->15:59: only the entry minute moves, because the neighbour names only the entry (in IDXRS_1000 the judge wrote 'ranking and entry' where he meant both). One pair a day.
readings_of_open_details.R9_stop_monitoring: Pair mark as in IDXRS_1000: pi = dir x [ln(P_us100 / P_us100,fill) - h x ln(P_leg2 / P_leg2,fill)] at exit-side prices (a long leg at its bid, a short leg at its ask). Hard rule 3: pi is marked on the close of every M1 bar from the entry bar to the bar before the exit bar (a leg without a bar in that minute keeps its last close). If pi <= -k x sd_pi, both legs are closed at the open of the next bar (for each leg its first bar at or after the next minute): long leg at bid x (1 - 0.5 bp), short leg at ask x (1 + 0.5 bp). A stop decided on the close of the bar before the exit bar is executed at the exit bar's open and pays the stop slippage. No intrabar trigger is assumed (an M1 frame cannot order the two legs' extremes).
readings_of_open_details.R10_time_exit: Both legs at the open of the first bar at or after the exit minute (15:59; 15:57 in (5); 16:05 in (6)): long leg at bid x (1 - 0.2 bp), short leg at ask x (1 + 0.2 bp). A leg with no bar from that minute to 16:59 New York is closed at its last close (counted and reported). No position crosses the 17:00 New York rollover: no swap.
readings_of_open_details.R11_R_unit: net pi = the pair mark at the actual fill and exit prices (spread and slippage inside them), log returns as the rule writes pi; R = net pi / (k x sd_pi), k = 1.5 in the main ('R = net pi / (1.5 x sd_pi)'), 1.25 / 1.75 in (7) / (8) (R per unit of the initial pair risk, as goldlab defines R; a constant k changes neither PF nor t). The money result with simple returns (N x (P/P_fill - 1) per leg, signed, leg 2 weighted by h) is reported beside it, not judged.
readings_of_open_details.R12_stop_floor: Hard rule 4: a pair is refused if k x sd_pi < 3 x (spread_us100 + h x spread_leg2), spreads = quoted (ask - bid) / mid at the open of the entry bar, on the frame of the run (widened in the stress run).
readings_of_open_details.R13_costs_and_stress: FP costs: spreads inside the FP frames (lab/data/fp; r2/fp_costs.json: 0.37 / 0.35 / 0.54 bp for us100 / us30 / us500 at the reference price, Dukascopy intraday shape), market slippage 0.2 bp per side per leg, stop slippage 0.5 bp per leg (= r2.costs(sym), identical for the three indices; the judge's '+0.6 bp on stop fills' is the 0.3 bp extra per leg on the two legs), no swap. Configuration 10: each leg's frame widened with goldlab.sim.apply_spread_mult(frame, 1.5) (mid unchanged, so the signals are unchanged) and both slippages x1.5 (0.3 bp market, 0.75 bp stop).
readings_of_open_details.R14_every_signal: One pair a day, intraday: no signal can be skipped for an open position, so the every-signal run IS the main run (signals refused by R12 or not filled by R8 are counted and reported).
readings_of_open_details.R15_null: Configuration 11: each filled pair of the main is replayed with the same legs (us100 / us30), the same direction (sides), the same hedge ratio h, the same stop level -1.5 x sd_pi and R unit 1.5 x sd_pi of the original trade, entry at the open of the 15:30 bar and time exit at the open of the 15:59 bar (the main's holding time), FP costs, the same fill and stop rules, on a session drawn uniformly with replacement among all sessions of the list (2013-09-30 .. 2021-12-31) on which both legs have a 15:30 bar. The replays are not re-filtered (no condition, no stop floor). 200 replays, numpy default_rng(0); statistic = mean R; percentile = share of replays whose mean R is below the main's; pass >= 97.5.
readings_of_open_details.R16_years: Years positive = calendar years of entry with at least one trade whose summed R > 0; bar >= 60 %.
readings_of_open_details.R17_neighbour_median: Neighbours = configurations 2-9 (eight); their median PF (median of eight = mean of the 4th and 5th values) must be >= 1.06. PF everywhere = profit factor on R (goldlab convention), FP costs.
readings_of_open_details.R18_knife_edge: Extra condition declared by the judge: PF of (5) exit 15:57 >= 1.06 AND PF of (6) exit 16:05 >= 1.06.
readings_of_open_details.R19_drop_rule_of_6: (6) is run unless the frames have (essentially) no quotes after 16:00 New York: data_check.py counts, on the sessions of the list, the days on which us100 and us30 BOTH have an M1 bar starting in [16:00, 16:10) New York; (6) is dropped (and logged as dropped in trials.jsonl) only if that share is below 50 %. If dropped, the neighbour median is taken over seven and the knife-edge condition is read on (5) alone, said so in the verdict.
readings_of_open_details.R20_weekly_correlation_reported: Weekly sums of R booked at the exit week (pandas weekly periods W-SUN of the UTC exit time, as goldlab.metrics), every calendar week from the week of 2014-01-01 to the week of 2021-12-31 counted (weeks without a trade = 0), Pearson. IDXRS_1000 = its main configuration's in-sample trades (results/r2/round4/idxrs_1000/trades_01_main.parquet, read with the filter entry_time < 2022-01-01); noise30 and the rest of the ten = their official trades (results/r2/recalc/trades, read with the filter entry_time < 2022-01-01 in the same statement; a trade exiting in 2022 dropped). Reported, not judged: with IDXRS_1000, with noise30, with the sum of the ten and with each of the three clusters.
readings_of_open_details.R21_split_by_direction_reported: The main's trades split by the day's direction: d > 0 (long us100 / short us30) and d < 0 (short us100 / long us30): n, expectancy, PF, total R, t, net bp. Also by year.
readings_of_open_details.R22_gross_reported: Gross: the same signals simulated on mid prices without slippage (mode 'mid'): gross bp per pair and gross PF, reported not judged; cost per pair = mid result at the trade's own minutes - net result.
readings_of_open_details.R23_checks_not_trials: Verification of the main only, not configurations: (a) synthetic unit tests of the two-leg simulator (no market data); (b) a hand check of 6 days recomputed from the raw in-sample bars with plain loops; (c) a cross-check of every pair of the main with IDXRS_1000's two-leg simulator (r2/tracks/round4/idxrs_1000/common.sim_pairs, imported read-only, on its own 09:30-16:00 grid; a short-us100 pair is passed to it as long us30 with weight 1/h and stop -k sd_pi / h, which is the same pair scaled by 1/h); (d) the truncation test of hard rule 3 on at least 50 decisions (entry decisions on frames cut at 15:30, stop decisions on frames cut at the end of the decision bar, no-stop checks cut inside the hold).
